description: Explicit state machine for the hybrid orchestration (plan phases 1-4). Every transition must carry actor, timestamp and reason -- no implicit jumps.

force_dry_run_when.note: A request satisfying either condition can only ever reach ready_for_staging with execution_mode=dry_run, regardless of what the submitter requested. This is normalized at intake, not enforced later.

notes: approved + validated:false is not a representable state -- normalize to changes_requested/needs_input at intake, per plan decision.
Duplicate approval events for a request already past awaiting_staging_approval must be idempotent no-ops, not new transitions.
